categories.name: IDR Stablecoin
categories.content: A IDR stablecoin is a type of cryptocurrency that is designed to maintain a stable value by being pegged to the Indonesian rupiah.

categories.name: Dinari Ecosystem
categories.content: The Dinari Ecosystem comprises tokens tokenized by Dinari.

categories.name: Tokenized Assets
categories.content: Tokenized products refers to digital representation of assets on a blockchain platform.

categories.name: Reddit Points
categories.content: Reddit Community Points are blockchain tokens that are owned and controlled by a specific Reddit community. With these point tokens, a community member can own a piece of their favorite subreddit. The points can be earned through contributions in the community such as post creation, comments, and content moderations.

categories.name: Real World Assets (RWA)
categories.content: Real World Assets (RWAs) refer to tangible or physical assets that have value in the real world. The tokenization of RWAs involves representing these assets digitally on a blockchain, allowing for fractional ownership, increased liquidity, and more efficient management and trading of these assets.

categories.name: Tokenized Treasuries
categories.content: Tokenized Treasuries feature blockchain-native representations of marketable sovereign debt including T-bills, T-notes, and T-bonds that offer 24/7 on-chain access to yields through regulated, asset-backed tokens.

categories.name: Printr Launchpad
categories.content: Printr is chain-abstracted token launchpad with customizable fee models and an on-chain 'Proof of Belief' staking mechanism that rewards long-term community commitment.

categories.name: Reserve Ecosystem
categories.content: Decentralized Token Folio (DTF) issued and created with the Reserve protocol's open-source contracts (developed by ABC Labs).

categories.name: Virtual Reality
categories.content: Virtual reality (VR) uses computer-generated environments to create a simulated experience for users.

categories.name: OpenServ Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokens launched on OpenServ, a multi-chain crowdfunding platform designed for autonomous startups and Agentic Applications (aApps) built on OpenServ’s AI reasoning infrastructure.

categories.name: MMO
categories.content: Online games that host large numbers of players.

categories.name: Zodiac-Themed
categories.content: Meme coins related to zodiac signs.

categories.name: daos.fun Ecosystem
categories.content: daos.fun Ecosystem consists of tokens that have active hedge funds on daos.fun.

categories.name: Venice Ecosystem
categories.content: Venice is a decentralized, privacy-first AI network that provides permissionless and uncensored access to Large Language Models (LLMs) through a distributed compute architecture.

categories.name: CreatorBid Ecosystem
categories.content: CreatorBid Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via creator.bid.

categories.name: Moonshot Ecosystem
categories.content: Moonshot Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via https://moonshot.money/.

categories.name: Made in USA
categories.content: Refers to cryptocurrencies that have significant connections to the United States, either through their founding team or company headquarters.

categories.name: Orynth Ecosystem
categories.content: Projects launched via Orynth, designed to let users trade on the attention and interest surrounding early-stage software products and MVPs.

categories.name: TimeFi
categories.content: TimeFi is a blockchain-based approach to treating time as a monetizable asset through tokenized productivity, verifiable commitments, and AI-driven incentives.
